name: box-conformance-coverage-v2
about: Core v2's conformance cases and the tests that check them (ticket M1-01, core-v2-m1-tickets.md § 2 and § 3). Declared by hand; `pnpm check:conformance` checks it against the case file (v2 cases, `core: "v2"`, BC-144 to BC-237, the last two added by later decisions through the plan's change queue, and v1 cases restated for v2 in their `v2` object) and the v2 tests, and renders docs/evidence/SH-V2-conformance-coverage.md.

tickets name implementation owners for M1, M2 and M3. Live M2 rows use the numbered M2 plan; retired prototype parts have no owner or test mapping. spinoffs preserve original source ids; dispositions record later spin-off cases mapped or withdrawn by decision.

`cases` map each M1 case (and any other) to its test ids: a Foundry test (`test_BCnnn_*`, `testFuzz_BCnnn_*`, `testInvariant_BCnnn_*`; a restated v1 case's as `test_BCnnn_v2_*`) in a .t.sol file under packages/contracts/test/box-v2, or a vitest or Playwright test whose title starts with the case (`BC-nnn …`; a restated v1 case `BC-nnn v2: …`). A test with its own `ticket` is written by that ticket; otherwise by the case's. Names are planned until the ticket writes them: the ticket may rename a test, updating this map in the same commit. Every M1 case maps to at least one test id, or the check fails.
Gates: G0 blocks the milestone for every box the case applies to; G1 blocks listing third-party tokens or boxes; G2 blocks one menu item; EV is evidence.

M3-01: BC-253..270 preserve the original plan allocations; BC-258/260/265/269 are withdrawn by F119. Every surviving M3 case requires named implementation tests. Existing non-BC Foundry tests use implementation:true and must exist in the exact named file; other names stay planned until written. Discovery is not execution. BC-239..252 and BC-271 are unallocated proposal references, reconciled by M2-01 under m2.planReferences; no new ids allocated.

M2-01: live BC-182..203 map to exact existing tests; status covered means the written unit scope, never an execution or release claim. status open carries named ticket/reason gaps even with partial tests. m2.requirements tracks cross-case integration. Historical proposed ids stay unallocated; m2.planReferences reconciles their original meanings without renumbering M3. Local conformance-v2.test.ts enforces this extension pending shared-checker integration.
